title: Lethe
html_source:
In Classical Greek, Lethe literally means “forgetfulness” or “concealment” and is related to the Greek word for “truth”: a-lethe-ia, meaning “un-forgetfulness” or “un-concealment”. The River Lethe in Greek Mythology has appeared many times in popular culture since the times of ancient Greece.
Wikipedia
